description: Land Acquisition - Amendments to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2002/22 of 17.01.2017, Mawathagama D/S Division and 2021/32 of 01.06.2017, Ganga Ihala Korale D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters, specifically amendments to land acquisition notices and corrections to claimant information for various land lots. It involves property ownership details, land registrations, and administrative corrections related to land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. The content focuses exclusively on land and property matters without involving government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories.
